readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine at dinner, when the husband made everyone show their watches
When the watches were shown at the temple bell's nine o'clock strike (Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine)
The temple struck ten while the doctor and Madame Monnier were playing cards in the salon
A moment after the doctor came back, the hall clock struck eleven

durations: A moment after he came back (between the doctor's return and the hall clock striking eleven)
whereabouts: Madame Monnier dined at the usual time.
Félix was at the table when the watches were shown at nine o'clock.
Monsieur Girard and Aurèle quarrelled about the price of the repeater at table.
Félix made jokes about his debts at dinner.
Madame Monnier and the doctor played piquet in the salon.
The doctor went out to fetch his cigars.
Madame Monnier sat down at the piano at once after the doctor left.
Madame Monnier played Chopin at the piano until the doctor came back.
Madame Monnier stopped playing when the doctor came in.
